modules.module_title: Maintain a safe and hygienic workplace

pcs.pc_description: undertake basic safety checks before operation of all machinery and equipment
assess risk prior to performing manual handling jobs
follow standard safety procedures while handling equipment and hazardous materials
take preventive actions to protect from leakages, water logging, pests, fire, pollution, etc.
identify contamination and cross- contamination risks and take steps to reduce them
observe hygiene and sanitation practices as per regulatory and workplace requirements
report hazards, breach of company safety procedures and accidents without delay to an appropriate authority
ensure segregation of waste as hazardous/ non-hazardous
dispose-off waste safely and correctly in the designated area

modules.module_title: Maintain an organized workplace as per 5S procedures

ensure extra material and all items are returned to the designated storage areas after work
ensure that storage area is organized and does not overflow
ensure work area is cleaned before and after completion of job/shift
inspect work area regularly for compliance to specified standards including 5S
follow the proper mechanism for labelling instruments, containers, chemicals etc.
maintain documents and records as per given coding procedures
use personal protective equipment (e.g. goggles, caps, shoes, etc.) as per workplace policy
handle heavy and hazardous materials with care using appropriate tools and equipment such as trolleys, ladders
follow procedures for dealing with accidents, fires, evacuations and emergencies as per company standards and workplace requirements
use emergency equipment in accordance with manufacturers' specifications and workplace requirements.
use the appropriate fire extinguishers on different types of fires correctly
avoid accidents while using hazardous chemicals, machines, sharp tools and equipment
provide appropriate first aid treatment as per recognized techniques.
report details of first aid administered in accordance with workplace procedures
